title: #shorts The " Name" Workout for Monday or Quick Workout
description:
Ready for your Monday workout? Let's go! 💪 #Workout #Fitness Stop scrolling, start moving! ⚡️ I'm spelling out D-R-E-Y today, which includes: ✅ 20 Plank Jacks, ✅ 10 Burpees, ✅ 15 Squats, ✅ 3-Minute Wall Sit. Minimalist wellness is about being capable anywhere—studio or garage. Drop your name and tell me which letter hurts the most! 👇 #SpellYourNameChallenge #VintageAthlete #MinimalistWellness #dreyFitness Your name is your workout. No excuses, show your strength! 🗣️👇
 The A-Z Challenge:
 A - 10 Burpees,
